cases.name: special_params
argv: set -- a b c; echo $#:$1:$2:$3; echo "$*"; echo "$@"

cases.name: if
argv: if true; then echo yes; else echo no; fi

cases.name: if_elif
argv: if false; then echo a; elif true; then echo b; else echo c; fi

cases.name: if_nested
argv: if true; then if false; then echo bad; else echo good; fi; fi

cases.name: while
argv: i=0; while [ $i -lt 3 ]; do echo $i; i=$((i+1)); done

cases.name: until
argv: i=0; until [ $i -ge 2 ]; do echo $i; i=$((i+1)); done

cases.name: for_in
argv: for x in a b c; do echo $x; done

cases.name: for_default
argv: set -- p q; for x; do echo $x; done

cases.name: for_quoted
argv: for x in "a b" c; do echo "[$x]"; done

cases.name: break_continue
argv: for i in 1 2 3 4; do if [ $i -eq 2 ]; then continue; fi; if [ $i -eq 4 ]; then break; fi; echo $i; done

cases.name: case
argv: case abc in a*) echo match;; *) echo no;; esac

cases.name: case_multi
argv: case xyz in a|b) echo ab;; x?) echo xq;; *) echo other;; esac

cases.name: func_local
argv: f(){ local x=inside; echo $x; }; x=outside; f; echo $x

cases.name: func_return
argv: f(){ echo before; return 4; echo after; }; f; echo status=$?

cases.name: pipeline_multi
argv: echo abc | tr a-z A-Z | rev

cases.name: and_or
argv: false && echo bad || echo good; true && echo yes || echo no

cases.name: redir_append
argv: echo one > out.txt; echo two >> out.txt; cat out.txt

cases.name: heredoc
argv:
cat <<EOF
line one
line two
EOF

cases.name: group
argv: x=a; { x=b; echo group=$x; }; echo main=$x

cases.name: glob_question
argv: touch ab ac ad; echo a?

cases.name: cd
argv: mkdir -p sub; cd sub; pwd; cd ..; pwd

cases.name: cd_dash
argv: mkdir -p sub; cd sub; cd -; pwd

cases.name: shift
argv: set -- a b c; shift; echo "$@"; echo $#

cases.name: set_errexit_cond
argv: set -e; if false; then :; fi; echo survived

cases.name: set_errexit_negated
argv: set -e; ! true; echo after; ! false; echo neg_status=$?

cases.name: set_xtrace
argv: set -x; echo traced 2> trace.txt; cat trace.txt

cases.name: test_string
argv: [ abc = abc ] && echo eq; [ abc != xyz ] && echo ne

cases.name: test_file
argv: touch f; [ -f f ] && echo file; [ -d . ] && echo dir; [ -z '' ] && echo zero

cases.name: read
argv: printf 'one two\n' | { read a b; echo "$a/$b"; }

cases.name: getopts
argv: set -- -a -b val; while getopts ab: o; do echo "$o:$OPTARG"; done

cases.name: umask_file_mode
argv: umask 077; umask; echo x > modefile; stat -c %a modefile

cases.name: glob_multicomponent
argv: mkdir -p d1/sub d2/sub; touch d1/sub/f d2/sub/f; echo */*/f

cases.name: glob_multicomponent2
argv: mkdir -p d1/sub; touch d1/sub/f d1/x; echo d1/*

cases.name: test_mtime
argv: touch -d 2020-01-01 old; touch -d 2021-01-01 new; [ old -ot new ] && echo ot; [ new -nt old ] && echo nt

cases.name: test_fifo
argv: mkfifo pp; [ -p pp ] && echo pipe; rm pp

cases.name: exec_redir
argv: exec 9>execout; echo hi >&9; exec 9>&-; cat execout

cases.name: case_mixed_quote
argv: case abc in a"b"*) echo M;; *) echo N;; esac

cases.name: case_mixed_quote_nomatch
argv: case axc in a"b"*) echo M;; *) echo N;; esac

cases.name: test_ot_equal
argv: touch -d 2020-01-01 a; touch -d 2020-01-01 b; [ a -ot b ] && echo OT || echo NOT

cases.name: test_ot_strict
argv: touch -d 2020-01-01 a; touch -d 2021-01-01 b; [ a -ot b ] && echo OT

cases.name: read_escaped_ifs
argv: printf 'a\ b c\n' | { read x y; echo "[$x][$y]"; }

cases.name: read_raw_escaped_ifs
argv: printf 'a\ b c\n' | { read -r x y; echo "[$x][$y]"; }

cases.name: nested_dq_single_quote
argv: x=set; echo "${x:+'b c' d}"; echo "${x:+"b c" d}"

cases.name: case_paren_pattern
argv: case m in (m) echo MATCH;; esac

cases.name: command_V
argv: command -V echo; command -V no_such_cmd_xyz; echo rc=$?
